description: Lending rates on Base: supply APY for every tracked money market and lending vault (Aave, Morpho, Compound, Moonwell and others), quoted next to the APY lenders actually earned over 7 and 30 days, read on-chain, with a risk score. Useful for choosing where to lend USDC, ETH or stablecoins. Ids work with every other route. 404 for unknown paths and 400 for invalid arguments, before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer.

asset.description: Token symbol, e.g. USDC or WETH.

realized_only.description: Only opportunities with a realized on-chain APY.

risk_max.description: Maximum risk score (0-100, lower is lower modelled risk).

sort.description: Order: risk_adjusted (default) ranks by opportunity score; realized_apy by the 30-day realized APY; sustainable_apy by the APY expected once incentives fade.

name: get_lending_rates
